primary_gt.formula_proof: The rainfall-process ledger wins because all five precipitation sources exceed 45 mm, process text support is complete, and the rainfall-process score is 86 versus an image-change score of 27. The image-change ledger cannot carry the diagnosis because both Sentinel streams have 0/0 usable pre/post scenes.

provenance.notes: Deterministic local computation from event metadata, reports, precipitation products, and Sentinel scene-count ledgers.

criteria.description: Gives 5 sources at or above 45 mm and mean consensus precipitation of 65.8 mm within 0.2 mm.
criteria.name: Rainfall threshold ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a correct count with an imprecise mean, or a correct mean with a missing threshold count; award 1 point for qualitative heavy-rain language only.

criteria.description: Gives the inclusive 1-day event window and Sentinel counts of S1 0/0 and S2 0/0, leading to sensor_window_index = 0.
criteria.name: Window ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct scene-count logic with one missing sensor stream or a wrong inclusive-day convention.

criteria.description: Uses 10 fatalities and 13 destroyed houses to compute impact_index = 76.
criteria.name: Impact arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for one correct impact input with the right formula; award 1 point for naming severe impacts without the arithmetic.

criteria.description: Computes rainfall_index = 87.7, rainfall_process_score = 86, image_change_score = 27, and score_margin = 59.
criteria.name: Score formula chain
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for using the right formulas with one arithmetic or rounding error; award 1 point for comparing the ledgers without numeric scores.

criteria.description: Connects metadata, storm triggering, following-storm report language, and deep-seated landslide movement to process_text_index = 100.
criteria.name: Physical process support
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming rainfall-triggered landslide without the source-check chain.

criteria.description: Returns rainfall_threshold_confirmed_deep_landslide_highest_field_urgency or an equivalent label with rainfall threshold confirmation, deep landslide movement, and highest field urgency.
criteria.name: Final diagnosis label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the right ledger but an incomplete label.

criteria.description: Includes the requested formula_proof explaining that the rainfall-process ledger wins by an 86-to-27 score because all precipitation sources pass, process support is complete, and both Sentinel streams have 0/0 usable pre/post scenes; keeps the interpretation bounded to a threshold-window score diagnosis rather than exact failure-depth or satellite-confirmed damage mapping.
criteria.name: Formula proof and interpretation bound
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for either the correct formula_proof logic or a clear interpretation bound.
